title: AgentGuard Coauthorization V1 Authorization Response
$comment: Source contract: backend/coauthorization/contracts.py:CoauthorizationResponse. credential references the unchanged frozen ROOT schema. SchemaStore(EXTENSION_SCHEMA_ROOT) alone cannot resolve that external resource; a response validator must register both frozen resources listed below by their existing $id. This annotation does not modify SchemaStore or permit network retrieval. Hash equality and current lifecycle checks require semantic verification outside JSON Schema.

approval_payload_hash.description: SM3 of canonicalize(bundle.payload), bound to the challenge and both approval statements.

bundle_hash.description: SM3 of canonicalize(the complete signed bundle), including both approval signatures. Approval array order is preserved by the frozen canonical JSON profile.

root_credential_hash.description: SM3 of canonicalize(credential), including its signature; must match the persisted signed root hash.

reused.description: False for new issuance. True only when the identical canonical signed bundle returns the original root after current task, policy, key, root and challenge lifecycle checks; the challenge must still be unexpired.

credential.description: The existing frozen ROOT credential, not a new extension credential format.
